assets.name: The Bell Without a Tower

canonical.locomotion: It cannot turn during a committed advance and brakes by striking the terrain.
canonical.sound: Memory bronze produces slow impacts whose interval shortens without their volume changing.
canonical.origin: A great bell walks on the remembered arms of every ringer crushed when its tower fell.
canonical.cue: A tower-shaped shadow rises upward from the bell.
canonical.counterplay: Stand inside the shadow's doorway, the only space the memory never crushed.

From behind the bell, one flat rain-black tower-shaped memory shadow rises vertically upward in empty backdrop space. assets.name: Rope Larva

canonical.purpose: It gathers loose ringing memories for larger revenants.
canonical.origin: Frayed tower ropes were buried while still remembering the hands that pulled them.
canonical.cue: A vertical ripple rises from the last ringing impact.
canonical.counterplay: Move beneath the ripple and cut the larva when it reaches the false ceiling.

assets.name: Cracked Acolyte

canonical.purpose: It searches settlements for bronze able to mend its remembered bell.

canonical.cue: Both halves lean away while the central crack brightens.
canonical.counterplay: Pass through the seam before the toll reunites the halves.

assets.name: Echo Sutler

canonical.anatomy: Small trade bells hang from shelves growing through a hollow torso.
canonical.locomotion: It steps only when an unseen customer places a memory on a shelf.
canonical.sound: Coins ring in currencies removed from every ledger.
canonical.purpose: It exchanges warm memories among revenants that can no longer make their own.
canonical.origin: A camp seller accepted a bell's remembered payment after every soldier had died.
canonical.cue: One shelf displays a scene taken from the current location.
canonical.counterplay: Break the empty price bell, not the displayed memory.
